input_messages.content: Hi! I actually need help with a couple of things. I recently moved to a new house, but it’s still on Elm Avenue here in Houston. I noticed that one of my recent orders was sent to my old address instead of the new one. I’d like to get that fixed, and also update my default address in your system to the new place. Can you help with that? I’d prefer not to give my address directly, but you should be able to see it in my orders.
Sure, my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account!

Yes, please update both my shipping and default address to my new place on Elm Avenue. I’d really appreciate it if you could make sure all future orders go to the new address as well. 

Also, while you’re looking at my orders, I’d like to exchange the tablet I recently bought for the cheapest tablet you have. Moving has been expensive, so I’m hoping to downgrade. Can you help with that too?

I’d really prefer not to say my address directly, but you should be able to tell which one is the new one based on the luggage set I just bought—that was definitely sent to my new place. Can you check which order has the luggage set and use that address for both my default and shipping address? And yes, please update both orders to that address.

As for the tablet, please go ahead and show me the details for exchanging it to the cheapest option. Thanks!
Yes, that all sounds good! Please go ahead and process the exchange for the cheaper tablet and update my addresses as discussed. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Thanks for letting me know! In that case, please cancel the tablet from my pending order instead. I’ll reorder the cheaper one myself once the refund goes through. Thanks for updating my addresses and helping with this!
Yes, please remove just the tablet from that order. Go ahead and process the cancellation and refund. Thanks for your help!
Let’s go ahead and exchange the tablet for the cheapest tablet option you mentioned earlier. Please process that exchange for me. Thanks for clarifying!
Yes, I confirm! Please proceed with the exchange and refund the difference. Thank you for your help with everything.

That’s perfect, thanks so much for your help! I’m all set now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
